import urllib.request,json,hashlib,http.cookiejar
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com/ayo/'
jar=http.cookiejar.CookieJar();client=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
checks=[]
paths=[('',b'ayoCharacterCanvas'),('app.js?v=6',b'createAyoAvatar'),('ayo-avatar.js',b'getByteTimeDomainData'),('style.css?v=6',b'.ayo-avatar-image'),('assets/ayo-character.webp',b'RIFF'),('api.php?action=status',b'emotionMode')]
for path,needle in paths:
 request=urllib.request.Request(base+path,headers={'User-Agent':'AYO-Official-Character-Release-Check/1.0','Cache-Control':'no-cache'})
 with client.open(request,timeout=8) as response:
  raw=response.read(200000)
  item={'path':path or '/','http':response.status,'length':len(raw),'has_marker':needle in raw,'mime':response.headers.get('content-type','')}
  if path=='assets/ayo-character.webp':
   item['sha256_ok']=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='0e3500349d51b91c474b124eed9556e3052c469a1470c86eb1d815441f417068'
   item['webp']=raw[8:12]==b'WEBP'
  if path.startswith('api.php'):
   j=json.loads(raw);item['config_has_emotion_mode']=bool(j.get('config',{}).get('emotionMode'))
  checks.append(item)
if any(x['http']!=200 or not x['has_marker'] or x.get('sha256_ok') is False or x.get('webp') is False or x.get('config_has_emotion_mode') is False for x in checks):raise RuntimeError('AYO official-character HTTPS smoke failed: '+json.dumps(checks))
print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','checks':checks}))
